mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT a.approval_id AS approvalId, ar.approval_revision_id AS revisionId, a.block_id AS blockId, ar.title AS title, a.user_id AS drafterId, a.acting_drafter_id AS actingDrafterId FROM approval a JOIN employee drafter ON drafter.user_id = a.user_id AND drafter.company_id = #{companyId} JOIN approval_revision ar ON ar.approval_id = a.approval_id AND ar.revision_no = a.current_revision_no AND ar.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN approval_line al ON al.approval_revision_id = ar.approval_revision_id AND al.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND al.user_id = #{userId} AND al.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'WAITING') ORDER BY a.approval_id

SELECT DISTINCT a.approval_id AS approvalId, ar.approval_revision_id AS revisionId, a.block_id AS blockId, ar.title AS title, a.user_id AS drafterId, a.acting_drafter_id AS actingDrafterId FROM approval a JOIN employee drafter ON drafter.user_id = a.user_id AND drafter.company_id = #{companyId} JOIN approval_revision ar ON ar.approval_id = a.approval_id AND ar.revision_no = a.current_revision_no AND ar.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.status IN ('IN_PROGRESS', 'REJECTED') AND (a.user_id = #{userId} OR a.acting_drafter_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY a.approval_id
